rationale: I ran one fixture unchanged against all three checked-out pins — tracked AGENTS.md carrying the overlay, no coord.installRoot in the clone and no installRoot argument, which is the vendored workspace at the centre of this issue's first requirement — and only claude e61aad3d4af48938c05092532a25c9d453c54786 kept the protocol block, while codex 4869a4b7c4a4f639c1e2915e5600198a749e438c and cursor 6121c0c17f4ebc60efc424f23f3526491079ca1c both left the clone holding the bare product file ('expected "# product v2\n" to contain "coordination protocol"') and then certified it as ready, because the lift has already run git checkout HEAD -- AGENTS.md by the time restore is reached and only claude's capture-before-lift fallback can put the overlay back without a template; cursor is additionally disqualified by an unguarded removeManagedBlock at src/prepareAgentBranch.ts:79 that throws ManagedBlockError out of initializeEffects into an uncaught runTick and terminates the coordinator (reproduced: THROWN_NAME=ManagedBlockError where codex and claude both give the intended refusal), and by the trimEnd() comparison codex found, which lets the lift silently destroy a human trailing-whitespace edit outside the managed block; codex is the closest and is genuinely better on one axis — it is the only pin that cross-checks overlayPresent in its readiness assertion, which claude and cursor both compute and never consume — so the correction claude should absorb is that assertion with its protocol === "overlay" guard removed, and both peer comparisons reached this same ranking independently.
